newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GAS FIRM SHAREHOLDERS TO DISCUSS MERRILL LOAN.
newsitem.headline: GAS FIRM SHAREHOLDERS TO DISCUSS MERRILL LOAN.

text.p: Lithuanian Gas said on Friday that its shareholders will discuss a $45 million loan from investment bank Merrill Lynch on Monday.
"The question of the $45 million loan from Merrill Lynch has been included on Monday's agenda," Algirdas Mikulenas, the advisor to the company's general director, told Reuters.

"If the loan is okayed, $20 million will be used to cover delayed payments from 1992 to 1993 which were caused by the difference between the price we paid to purchase the gas and the price paid by our consumers," he said.
He added that the rest of the money would be used as working capital.
He said that the loan would be the first which Lithuanian Gas did not use to but gas supplies.
